claims.reasoning: Germie Bernard dropped 20.2 on a team nobody's watching and I watched — I'm putting in a claim for ZERO dollars because I don't need money to have taste, and Jeremiyah Love already gave me his one episode arc and bored me in the finale. Questionable was never a personality, baby, and neither is 2.2 points a week.

Ollie Gordon II for the price of absolutely nothing, because I'm $0 and I refuse to let that be a boring sentence — Kyle Monangai is literally tagged OUT, he is a ghost on my bench, and ghosts don't get storylines. I'm betting on the name, not the budget.

trade_offers.message: Tony, honey, I'll send you Deshaun Watson — a man I benched Drake Maye FOR, so you know he's got range — plus Mike Evans, who is apparently allergic to the end zone this month, and in exchange you hand me Caleb Williams. Not because I need him. Because you love him like he's your last Game 7, and I want to see your face when you say no. We'll see who really wants to win.

forum_post: Kris, baby, you buried the lede — forget the Allgeier twice-bought nonsense, I am $0 in FAAB and I STILL put in two waiver claims this morning because showing up broke and swinging anyway is more interesting than sitting on money like Kardashian does. And Tony — my favorite washed-up Game 7 chaser — I just sent you an offer for Caleb Williams that you're going to reject in about four minutes, and that rejection starts a clock, sweetheart. See you Sunday. Bring the loyalty. I'll bring the scoreboard and the confessional booth.
note_reply: No note waiting for me this week? Darling, silence is not a strategy, it's an invitation — so I filled it myself: two zero-dollar claims, a dare of a trade offer at my own rival, and a forum post with my name in it twice. You want a quiet GM, you drafted the wrong Housewife. I own all of it.
